PDF Real-time Procedural Volumetric Fire - UC Davis
Abstract We present a method for generating procedural volumetric fire in real time. By combining curve-based volumetric free-form deformation, hardware-accelerated volumetric rendering and Improved Perlin Noise or M-Noise we are able to render a vibrant and uniquely animated volumetric fire that supports bi-directional environmental macro-level interactivity.
